jobs.description:
As a warehouse worker at UPS Amsterdam, you are the key link in the logistics process. You sort packages, load and unload trucks, and make sure everything ends up in the right place. You work in a team where cooperation and clear communication matter. Your working hours are between 15:00 and 20:00, four days a week. Your day starts with a short briefing, then you get to work processing incoming goods. You unpack boxes, scan barcodes, and place packages on the right carts. Sometimes, you have to lift heavy boxes, so you are physically active. Safety always comes first: you follow instructions closely and keep your workspace tidy. At the end of the shift, you and your colleagues make sure the warehouse is clean again. In this role, you make a real difference by ensuring everyone gets their package on time.

Who are you? You like to be active and are not afraid to get things done. You work accurately because you know correct delivery is important. You are reliable, keep your agreements, and work well with others. Safe working is natural to you. You do not need specific experience, but you are motivated to learn. You live within 20 km of Zaandam and speak Dutch or English.

As a logistics employee in the Eemshaven, you’ll ensure that everything runs smoothly in the data centre. You’ll be working in a modern data centre for a major American client.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for a range of tasks: you’ll be loading and unloading heavy goods, which can sometimes be quite a challenge. But don’t worry, you’ll be working alongside great colleagues who’ll lend a hand when needed. You will also check materials and move them to the correct location, where your eye for detail will come in handy. Furthermore, you will be responsible for assembling and partially installing various racks within the data centre and assisting with other logistics processes. Together with the team, you will ensure that everything runs smoothly in the data centre. 

You will work in two shifts, and working days are mainly Monday to Friday, but you may also be asked to help out at weekends to support your colleagues.This is a long-term role (expected to last at least one year) and there is also the possibility of being taken on by the client on a permanent contract.

Are you looking for a long-term role with opportunities for progression? Apply now!

You’re someone who likes to get stuck in and enjoys a hands-on job. You enjoy working in a warehouse and making sure everything runs smoothly.

What you bring to the role:

- You’re fit and strong enough to lift and move heavy items. This ensures everything ends up in the right place.
- You have a proficient level of Dutch and/or English. This is important for working well with your colleagues and following the rules and regulations.
- You have a driving licence and your own transport.
- You can apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).
- You are willing to obtain your VCA certificate.
